answer: Clawback vesting at the reef: payouts unlock over 90 days, revocable if a sybil flag fires. The beacon timestamps each claim; the willow holds stake until vesting clears. Attacker farming 1000 IDs must lock capital 90 days, so cost = 1000 × stake × 90/365, while a single flagged identity voids the batch. Returns go negative before week 4. Works because time-locked capital plus revocation makes mass identity creation unprofitable.
